changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Keep only the newest unresolved payment attempt, then enforce one active attempt per assignment.
changeSet.sql:
WITH ranked_active AS ( SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY job_assignment_id ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC ) AS position FROM payments WHERE is_deleted = false AND status IN ('INITIATED', 'IN_REVIEW') ) UPDATE payments AS payment SET status = 'FAILED', completed_at = COALESCE(payment.completed_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), failure_reason = 'Superseded while enforcing one active payment attempt.' FROM ranked_active WHERE payment.id = ranked_active.id AND ranked_active.position > 1;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uk_payments_one_active_attempt ON payments (job_assignment_id) WHERE is_deleted = false AND status IN ('INITIATED', 'IN_REVIEW');
